driver_note: Initial normal-response wait timed out because its prompt included the fixture trigger word approval. The resulting real approval was accepted and verified; a neutral prompt then demonstrated streaming. No application source change was made during this run.
scope: Real component manager, packaged GUI, native App Server, native tools/approvals/cancellation and independently compiled selected native storage. Model output is deterministic fixture data, not a paid remote model. Graceful startup/active-turn shutdown/cold recovery pass; forced uncertainty/reaping is verified separately in manager-shutdown-reaping-acceptance.json.
